answer: Rate-limited query budget.** Each identity may spend only a fixed fraction of its daily inference budget, and unused budget lapses rather than accumulating. To act, an attacker must keep every puppet active continuously, paying real model and hosting costs across the whole nebula of accounts. A grove of identities only maintains standing if each one queries often enough to stay warm. Because an abandoned orchard row yields nothing, sustaining N sybils costs roughly N times the attention overhead of one honest agent.
